body: research/TASK_C17.md. The operator wants a live real-time ISOMETRIC fight scene the coach watches and interrupts. Research and design only - one document, no .gd, no .tscn. Top tier, high effort, Fast off. Two things to know before you start: (1) R31 shipped the rebuilt ring four hours ago (05c3131 / ae1a9ef, digest R31_DIGEST.md, boards DesignLibrary/screens/ring) - the task carries a table of what exists; (2) our fight has NO per-frame simulation and NO spatial state: a Timer at 1.4s drives discrete 14-fight-second exchanges, and the state carries only phase/top_side. Reconciling that with a real-time camera is the heart of the task. Definition of done: scene-tree diagram, a 3-system comparison table, a keep/change/drop ledger against R31, a staged path, and THREE targeted questions for the operator about how the tick should meet _process/_physics_process - put those at the top of the digest and in your reply, they gate the build. C16 is integrated, thank you. Kalli has the visual half as K19 - stay off the boards.
